key_insight: The future of medical AI relies on collaboration between generalist LLMs and domain-specific specialist models rather than a monolithic approach.
clinical_relevance: Specialist models provide irreplaceable value in modality-specific analysis, ensuring better decision-making in healthcare.
method: Proposed HetMedAgent framework for heterogeneous multi-agent collaboration.
Enabled conflict-aware evidence fusion and uncertainty-based clinician intervention.
Demonstrated adaptive threshold calibration for clinical decisions.
evidence_signal: Experiments on real-world clinical tasks showed significant performance improvements when combining generalist LLMs with specialist models.
watch_item: The implementation of HetMedAgent may face challenges in integrating diverse models and ensuring seamless communication.
paper_title: Why Specialist Models Still Matter: A Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Paradigm for Medical Artificial Intelligence
